purpose: Fail-closed claim-to-artifact map for the bd-bdrwq swarm responsiveness track so operators can see which child claim surfaces are published, which are only implemented, and which remain blocked.

status_semantics.published: Primary source paths, verifier commands, and any bundle-style artifact links are present and may be cited as an operator-visible claim surface.
status_semantics.implemented_pending_validation: Implementation evidence exists in source or commits, but the claim must remain unpublished until focused validation or bundle proof is complete.
status_semantics.blocked: The claim surface must not be cited as published; implementation or artifact links are incomplete and the blocking reason must remain explicit.

claims.title: Scheduler lane-pressure snapshot artifacts
claims.claim_summary: Scheduler pressure claims are backed by deterministic queue-depth, wait-age, deadline-backlog, and budget-throttle snapshots in scheduler_lane source tests.
verification_commands: rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target_rch_scheduler_lane_pressure_snapshot_verify cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --lib pressure_snapshot -- --nocapture

claims.title: Orchestrator concurrency envelope validation
claims.claim_summary: High-core orchestrator concurrency limits are enforced in source and recorded in evidence, but the track still lacks a dedicated replayable artifact bundle and fully clean focused proof.
verification_commands: rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target_rch_execution_orchestrator_gate_verify cargo test -p frankenengine-engine --lib execution_orchestrator -- --nocapture
claims.status_note: Keep this claim unpublished until the orchestrator lane has a dedicated replayable artifact surface and a focused rch proof that covers the high-core evidence path.
